documents.title: Second appeal judgment
pages:
S.A.No.2207 of 2018
IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT MADRAS
RESERVED ON : 11.02.2024
DELIVERED ON : 19.03.2024
CORAM
THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE K.ARUNACHALAM
S.A.No.2207 of 2018
M.Velan ... Appellant
Vs
1.S.Ponni
2.R.Kathir ... Respondents
Prayer: Second Appeal filed under Section 100 of the Code of Civil Procedure against the judgment and decree.
The plaintiff claimed title under a sale deed. Section 53A of the Transfer of Property Act was relied upon. The first appellate court reversed the findings.
For the reasons stated above, the Second Appeal is dismissed. No costs.
